scope: Endpoint error in the complete mass-normalized pressure and face-velocity state, relative to the identical semidiscrete full system.
reduced_models: Unmodified Ritz spaces, frequencies and initial coefficients from accuracy_cost/results. No basis or cutoff is retuned.
bound: ||B-Wa|| + sqrt(T * a^T[(F^T F) elementwise G_T]a), F=C C^T W-W diag(lambda), G_T=integral_0^T g(t)g(t)^T dt, g_j=sin(sqrt(lambda_j)t)/sqrt(lambda_j), with g_j=t at zero.
reference: Sparse first-order exponential at T=2 and 8; both pressure and velocity retained.
floating_point: Analytic Gram integration in float64. Negative Gram eigenvalues are raised to zero; a recorded positive diagonal guard and relative 1e-11 final guard are applied. These are checked floating-point evaluations, not interval-certified bounds.
selection: The smallest tested dimension satisfying each bound threshold is selected separately for each material, grid, method, source and final time. Full-reference errors are used only to audit the selection.
